target: any non-cancelled order item actual shipping days > scheduled days; validate against published label
maturity: max(shipping timestamp, order timestamp + actual days) + 7 days; assumed observation lag, not recorded availability
history: training rows only, label available strictly before prediction; validation/test freeze at train_end
graph: product/category/market co-occurrence degrees from strictly earlier training orders; frozen at train_end for holdouts
selection: maximum validation average precision; ties prefer earlier candidate; test evaluated once after all selection
threshold: validation F1 maximum on 0.05..0.95 step 0.05; ties prefer lower threshold
limitations: currency not documented; amounts are original units
